topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 54 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 13 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (leadrate, upgradeabilityproxy, proxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
